offering_description.value: Vail Resorts sells ski passes, lift tickets and lessons to skiers and snowboarders at the mountain resorts it operates. It owns or manages lodging and offers dining, equipment rentals, retail and summer recreation. It also develops and sells resort-area real estate.

primary_products.value: ski and snowboard equipment; outdoor apparel and accessories; resort-area homes and development parcels

primary_services.value: ski lift and trail access; ski and snowboard instruction; lodging and vacation rental management; resort dining; equipment rental

customer_segment.value: B2C: skiers, snowboarders, vacationers and resort property buyers; B2B: corporate groups, event planners and owners of managed lodging properties

end_markets.value: skiing and snowboarding; leisure travel and hospitality; outdoor recreation retail; resort real estate

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: season passes, day lift tickets and summer activity tickets; service fees: ski lessons, overnight stays, dining and resort events; rental or leasing: short-term rentals of skis, snowboards and related gear; product sales: outdoor gear, apparel and resort-area real estate; commissions or management fees: management of third-party lodging and vacation rental properties
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; rental or leasing; product sales; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates lifts, trails and lodging on owned or permitted sites for vacationers; service provider: uses resort staff and facilities to teach and serve guests and manage lodging for property owners; retailer: buys outdoor gear and apparel from suppliers and sells them to resort guests and other outdoor consumers; other: develops resort-area land and sells homes or parcels to buyers and developers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; retailer; other

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Australia and Switzerland

specialization.value: related lines: mountain resorts, lodging, dining, outdoor retail and rentals, and resort real estate

distribution_channels.value: online: company pass, lift ticket, lodging and rental booking websites; own locations: resort ticket offices, ski schools, lodging properties, and retail and rental shops; direct sales: group and event sales teams; partners / resellers: travel wholesalers and third-party lodging booking platforms
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: U.S. Forest Service permits for resorts on federal land, plus lift safety and environmental rules
